blind.description: A stylized steampunk or fantasy alchemical vat/containment tank. It features a brass or gold metal cylindrical cage with a domed top, riveted bands, and four small bracketed feet supporting the base. Inside sits a cylindrical chamber filled with murky green liquid containing faint glowing dots or bubbles. A hand-wheel valve sits atop the domed cap, and a curved copper pipe runs vertically down one side between the top and bottom bands. The model is clean, solid, and fully manifold with cohesive textures and smooth stylized geometry.
blind.from_above: A circular brass dome centered around an eight-spoked handwheel valve, with a curved copper pipe protruding from one side and four small feet brackets extending slightly past the circular profile.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly 60% of the figure's height) and about 1.8 feet wide across the feet.
